articles.headline: Trump Issues Waivers on Russian Oil Purchases
articles.brief: Former US President Donald Trump has submitted a congressional certification to waive sanctions and tariffs on Russian oil and gas purchases, aiming to ease import pressures and inflation for major buyers like India amidst high global crude prices.

articles.headline: Supreme Court Rules Internet Access a Fundamental Right
articles.brief: The Supreme Court declared internet access a fundamental right applicable to all individuals, including children, rejecting blanket bans. The landmark ruling emphasizes balancing minor safety and digital freedom online.

articles.headline: India Widens Rupee Defence Cautiously
articles.brief: Indian authorities have widened their currency defense strategy to rates while maintaining a cautious approach amid shifting global economic currents, rising crude costs, and ongoing trade negotiations.

articles.headline: Central Bankers Eye Higher Rates Amid AI Boom
articles.brief: Central bankers worldwide are considering higher interest rates as the artificial intelligence boom fuels an unprecedented global scramble for cash and drives up capital investment demands.

articles.headline: Global Economy Resilient as Delegates Walk Out on Russia
articles.brief: The IMFC chair reported that the global economy remains resilient despite ongoing geopolitical tensions. However, tensions flared during proceedings as delegates staged a walkout on a Russian official.

articles.headline: Pakistan Ranks Poorly in Global Hunger Index
articles.brief: Pakistan ranked 106th out of 122 countries in the 2026 Global Hunger Index, reflecting serious food insecurity driven by economic hardship, rising food prices, and severe climate shocks.

articles.headline: Indian Police Detain 'Cockroach' Movement Founder
articles.brief: Indian police have detained the founder of the 'cockroach' movement alongside several student leaders ahead of a planned protest rally in Delhi, reflecting heightened political tensions and surging dissent.

articles.headline: Renault Bets Big on Hybrids and CNG in India
articles.brief: Renault's India CEO announced a strategic pivot toward hybrid and CNG vehicles, aiming to transform the automaker's sales mix and capture a larger share of the evolving domestic market.

articles.headline: DLF Focuses on Housing Sales and Rental Income
articles.brief: DLF Managing Director Ashok Tyagi highlighted housing sales, healthy margins, and expanding rental income as the three primary growth engines driving the real estate giant's future business strategy.

articles.headline: Mahela Jayawardene Steps Down as MI Head Coach
articles.brief: Mahela Jayawardene has officially stepped down from his position as head coach of the Mumbai Indians franchise ahead of upcoming tournament cycles, concluding a notable tenure with the IPL team.

articles.headline: AB de Villiers Reflects on Virat Kohli's Early Career
articles.brief: Former South African cricket star AB de Villiers shared insights into his early impressions of Virat Kohli, noting that the Indian batsman's initial intense confidence was frequently misread as arrogance.
articles.dateLocation: October 17, 2026 | New Delhi / Times of India

articles.headline: SpaceX Spectrum Deal Falls Short of Telecom Giants
articles.brief: Despite securing a new spectrum agreement, SpaceX's cellular initiatives still lag significantly behind established traditional telecommunication giants in nationwide network scale and subscriber base.

articles.headline: Vedanta Boss Praises Elon Musk's Flying Car Concept
articles.brief: Vedanta Chairman Anil Agarwal expressed awe at Elon Musk's latest technological demonstration featuring a redesigned Tesla Roadster capable of aerial maneuvers, likening it to science fiction.

articles.headline: Ten Charred to Death in Bangladesh Resort Fire
articles.brief: A tragic fire swept through a popular seaside resort in Bangladesh, leaving at least ten people charred to death. Local emergency services launched an investigation to determine the cause.
